inputs.text: The Donald Trump administration's decision to have the US pull out of the Paris Agreement for the second time is devastating. It represents a further entrenchment of systemic inequalities that permit powerful nations and corporate interests to dodge responsibility for the climate crisis resulting from centuries of exploitation and greed. It's the marginalized communities that will face the harshest consequences, depending on international frameworks to cope with the disasters stemming from profit-driven systems. Rather than defending these broken institutions, we must pursue structural reforms to protect the vulnerable.

subtopics: Structural reforms to protect vulnerable people
